name: us023-legacy-mapping-story-only
description: 023, Phase 6, US4, T104 (contract role-lifecycle-config.md §6 B1/B2): a role-blind mapping (every key a lifecycle event, written before roles existed) keeps its current meaning for the story role -- COMP-2 advances to "In Progress" -- while never starting to move a specification-tier parent on the strength of that mapping: it normalises to an EMPTY `specification` map (FR-020), so the parent's own target is always "" and its lifecycle-safety entry is never evaluated against any step, even though the mock declares a reachable, ungated move for it too (id 301, same destination name "In Progress") -- proving the parent is never read for transitions at all, not merely that it doesn't match.

content.text: We need to prove a declared mapping moves a recognised story to its agreed step.
As a user, I want the first capability.
**Given** a starting state **When** the user acts **Then** the first outcome happens
